title: Sep 12 Results + Sep 13 Preview: Twelve Wins and a Whole Lot of Validation
summary: 80% accuracy on Sep 12 with 12-3 record. Detroit tops tomorrow's card at 69%.

content.value:
## Another Night, Another Reminder

You know what I've learned after covering this game for more years than I care to admit? When you hit 80% on a 15-game slate, you don't overthink it. You tip your cap, take the win, and get ready for tomorrow.

September 12th was one of those nights where the model hummed like a well-oiled machine. Twelve winners out of fifteen attempts. The kind of night that reminds you why we trust the numbers when the gut wants to get fancy.

## The Breakdown: What Worked and What Didn't

Let's start with the good stuff. The Tigers took care of business against Colorado—exactly what we expected with that 63% confidence. The Rays handled Houston at home, the Padres got it done in San Francisco, and even those coin-flip calls on the Nationals and Twins came through.

The misses? Look, the Yankees dropping one to the Mets in the Subway Series—that's baseball in September. And the Dodgers falling to Miami? I've seen stranger things in Florida. These weren't bad reads, just bad breaks.

## Looking Ahead: September 13th

Here's the thing about back-to-back nights—momentum matters, but so does staying humble. We're riding high off an 80% night, but tomorrow's a new slate.

The model's most confident play for Saturday? We're going right back to the well with Detroit. The Tigers host Colorado again, and we're bumping our confidence up to 69%. Jackson Jobe gets the ball for Detroit against Gabriel Hughes, and the matchup metrics love what they see.

## The Veteran's Take

I've been doing this long enough to know that 80% nights don't come around every day. But I've also been around long enough to know that one good night doesn't make a season, and one bad night doesn't break a model.

What matters is consistency. Process over results. Trust over trends.

The Tigers have been a reliable play at home, and when the model gives you a near-70% confidence level in mid-September, you listen. We'll ride with Detroit again and see where the chips fall.

Same time tomorrow, folks. Let's make it two strong nights in a row.
